title.es: Taller de la Fragua: partes de palabras

objective.en: Build words from a prefix, a base word and a suffix, explain what each part means, and use the new words in your own sentences.
objective.es: Construir palabras con prefijo, palabra base y sufijo, explicar qué significa cada parte y usar las palabras nuevas en tus propias oraciones.

success.en: I can say what re-, un-, -er, -ful and -less mean.
success.es: Puedo decir qué significan re-, un-, -er, -ful y -less.

success.en: I can build a word to match a meaning.
success.es: Puedo construir una palabra que coincida con un significado.

success.en: I can use the clues in a sentence to pick the right word.
success.es: Puedo usar las pistas de una oración para elegir la palabra correcta.

success.en: I can write my own sentence with a word I built.
success.es: Puedo escribir mi propia oración con una palabra que construí.

narrative: Bram the Word Architect runs a forge where words are built from parts. Put a beginning, a middle and an ending together and watch the new word glow. If the parts do not make a word, the forge stays dark. That is not a mistake. It tells you to try other parts.

scene.alt: A warm workshop with a glowing forge, an anvil and shelves of labeled word-part tiles. Bram the Word Architect stands by the anvil holding a small hammer.

vocab.def: A word part added to the beginning of a word.
A word part added to the end of a word.
The main word that the parts are added to.
What a word or a word part tells you.

items.prompt: Build words. Pick a beginning (optional), a base word and an ending (optional). Press Forge it. Build at least four real words and open each meaning.

|play|ful.meaning: full of fun, ready to play

un|pack|.meaning: to take things out of a bag or box

un|lock|.meaning: to open a lock; the opposite of lock

|help|less.meaning: without help; not able to help yourself

items.prompt: Bram gives you four word orders. Build the word that matches each meaning.

tasks.ask: Build a word that means 'to write again'.
Build a word that means 'full of help'.
Build a word that means 'not helpful'.
Build a word that means 'without care'.

items.prompt: Use the clues. Which word fits? 'Mia was ___ with her new puppy. She gave it water, a soft bed and a gentle pat.'

options.label: careless
options.fb: 'Careless' means without care. Do the clues show care?

options.label: helpless
options.fb: 'Helpless' means without help. Mia is the one giving help.

options.label: unpack
options.fb: 'Unpack' is an action word, and this sentence needs a describing word.

items.why: The clues show Mia giving water, a soft bed and a gentle pat. That is care, and the sentence needs a word that describes how she acted. “Careful” fits both.

items.prompt: Write your own sentence with at least one word you built. Make the sentence show what the word means.
items.purpose: Words you use in a sentence stay with you.

checks.label: Uses a word you built
checks.hint: Use any word you forged in this mission.

checks.label: Is a complete sentence with an end mark

ladder.model: Model: Leo was helpful because he carried the heavy boxes for his neighbor.
ladder.cue: Use your word. Show what it means.

items.prompt: Make your sentence longer and clearer. Add where, when or why.
items.purpose: More detail makes your meaning clearer.

checks.label: Still uses a word you built

ladder.model: Model: Leo was helpful yesterday because he carried the heavy boxes up the stairs for his neighbor.
ladder.frame: My sentence with a new detail: ___ (where / when / why) ___.
ladder.partial: I added ___ to tell where, when or why.

stages.title: A word the forge has never seen

items.prompt: Bram has a new word: 'rethink'. You know re- and you know think. What does 'rethink' most likely mean?

options.label: not to think
options.fb: Does re- mean 'not'? Check what re- meant in the forge.

options.label: a person who thinks
options.fb: That meaning comes from an ending like -er. Look at the beginning of the word instead.

options.label: without thinking
options.fb: That meaning comes from -less. Look at the beginning of the word instead.

items.why: The prefix re- means “again” and the base word is think, so “rethink” means to think again. With an unfamiliar word, look at the beginning first.

endings.title: The forge glows
endings.text: Bram hammers the last tile into place. 'You built the word, explained its parts, and then made your sentence clearer. Parts plus meaning plus your own sentence: that is word power.'

endings.title: The forge is lit
endings.text: Bram nods. 'You built real words from parts and used them in your own sentence. Next time, add a detail to make the sentence tell more.'

skill.en: building words from a prefix, a base word and a suffix, and knowing what each part means
skill.es: construir palabras con prefijo, palabra base y sufijo y saber qué significa cada parte

talk.en: Ask: 'What word did you build? What does each part mean? Can you use it in a sentence?'
talk.es: Pregunta: '¿Qué palabra construiste? ¿Qué significa cada parte? ¿La puedes usar en una oración?'
